about.title: About ProAASI
about.subtitle: A project designed for accessibility, autonomy, and inclusion.
about.paragraph1: The Individual Sound Amplification Device Orientation and Adaptation Program (ProAASI) is a digital educational platform developed within the Graduate Program in Speech-Language Pathology of the Department of Speech-Language Pathology at the Bauru School of Dentistry, University of São Paulo (FOB-USP).
about.paragraph2: The project is supervised by Prof. Dr. Wanderleia Quinhoneiro Blasca (USP), in partnership with the University of Montreal under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Adriana B. M. de Lacerda, and with the Computer Science Program at UniSagrado (Bauru), under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Vinicius S. Andrade.
about.paragraph3: ProAASI includes the participation of Speech-Language Pathology students from USP Bauru: Flávia Pequin, Lucas Néri, and Vivian Vespero. The website was developed by Mariana Fernandes, a Computer Science graduate from UniSagrado.
about.paragraph4: The platform aims to provide accessible, evidence-based information about the use and handling of Individual Sound Amplification Devices (ISAD), as well as communication strategies designed both for older adults with hearing loss and for their communication partners. The content was structured in a clear, versatile, and user-friendly way, allowing it to be consulted whenever needed.

tutorial.title: How to Use ProAASI
tutorial.subtitle: This website was created to be simple, accessible, and easy to use.

steps.title: Choose a module
steps.text: Select one of the modules to learn about hearing, hearing aids, and communication.

steps.title: Watch the video
steps.text: Each module includes an explanatory video with simple language and captions.

steps.title: Read at your own pace
steps.text: Below the video, you will find short texts that reinforce the content.

steps.title: Customize the website for you
steps.text: You can increase text size, change the language, and navigate calmly.

tutorial.calm: Don’t worry — you can browse calmly. It’s not possible to make mistakes or break the website. Whenever you want, use the Back button or the top menu.
